title: WORKFLOW.md frontmatter (AIP-15)
description: Validates the YAML frontmatter portion of an AIP-15 WORKFLOW.md manifest.

inputs.description: Defined by AIP-16 — the IO `inputs` block.

outputs.description: Defined by AIP-16 — the IO `outputs` block.

result.description: Optional value expression mapping step results to the workflow output, using the same reference grammar as a step's `inputs` ($input.*, $steps.<id>.*, literals). Omitted ⇒ the output is the final step's result. Its shape SHOULD satisfy `outputs`.

inputsFiles.description: Defined by AIP-16 — the IO `inputsFiles` block.

outputsFiles.description: Defined by AIP-16 — the IO `outputsFiles` block.

runtime.description: Defined by AIP-17 — the runner block.

jsonSchema.description: Any JSON Schema draft 2020-12 document. Validation deferred to a meta-validator.

stepApproval.description: A human-in-the-loop gate. The HOST resolves the step — it MUST park the run (visible in its status output, e.g. an `awaitingApproval` record) and wait for a human decision; it MUST NOT auto-approve. The decision carries `who` (who decided) and an optional `note`, and is recorded on the host's state ledger (`by: "human"`) — state is written only from gate results and approvals. `timeout_ms` bounds the wait: when it elapses with no human decision, the host resolves the step as REJECTED with `who: "timeout"` (the `on_timeout`/`on_reject` branch, never an approval).

with.description: Optional input projection for the child workflow — an alias of `inputs` with identical semantics. Each key is a field of the child's `$input`; each value is either a literal, a reference to a parent input field (`$input.*`), or a reference to a prior step's output (`$steps.<id>.*`), resolved against the PARENT's bindings when the step runs. A referenced field that does not exist is an error naming the step and key — never a silent `undefined`. A step with neither `with` nor `inputs` passes the parent's own input object to the child verbatim. Declaring both `with` and `inputs` on one step is invalid.

harness.description: Harness pinning for a `kind: "agent"` step's spawn. Precedence when a field is also set elsewhere: step `harness` (highest) > the resolved AGENT.md's own frontmatter > `app_run` caller args > the adapter's own default (lowest).

model.description: Model id override for this spawn.

effort.description: Reasoning-effort override for this spawn (adapter-defined vocabulary, e.g. "low" | "medium" | "high").

role.description: Spawn-time role governing the child's tool-policy disposition (e.g. "executor" | "supervisor").

tools.description: Per-spawn tool allowlist. Applied where the resolved adapter supports a generic per-spawn allowlist mechanism; where it doesn't, the host records `toolsApplied: false` on the step's run record and emits a warning event instead of silently ignoring the field.

skills.description: Skill ids auto-mounted into the spawn — adapters with no such option (e.g. claude-code, which auto-discovers skills) ignore it.

cwd.description: Working directory override for this step's spawn; takes precedence over the run-level cwd.

promptFile.description: Read this file (relative to the WORKFLOW.md's directory) at load time and use its contents as the step's `prompt`, replacing any inline `prompt`.

promptSha.description: Computed by the loader at load time — sha256 (hex) of `promptFile`'s raw bytes. Not hand-authored; present only when `promptFile` was resolved.

knowledge.description:
AIP-10 corpus knowledge to materialize into this step's working directory before the session runs. For each selector, the host resolves the workspace (relative paths resolve against the WORKFLOW.md's own directory), queries its refined `entries/**/*.md` (anyOf = tag OR, allOf = tag AND post-filter, kinds = refined-kind filter), sorts matches by slug ascending, caps at `maxEntries` (default 50), and writes each raw entry (frontmatter + body) to `<cwd>/.knowledge/<workspaceBasename>/<slug>.md` plus a deterministic `<cwd>/.knowledge/INDEX.md` (one `- [<title>](<relpath>) — kind, tags` line per entry, grouped per workspace). One line naming the INDEX is prepended to the step's prompt. An empty match is not an error — it is recorded (`matched: 0`) and warned via the harness-warning event (`knowledge-empty`). Mode is v1 `"files"` only; `"tool"` is reserved. Example:

knowledge:
  - workspace: ../corpus-writer
    anyOf: [book-factory, drafting]
    allOf: [style-guide]
    kinds: [fact]
    maxEntries: 20
    mode: files

knowledgeSelector.description: One AIP-10 corpus workspace attachment on a `kind: "agent"` step's `harness.knowledge[]` — see the `harness.knowledge` description for the full materialization contract. String fields (`workspace`, `anyOf[]`, `allOf[]`, `kinds[]`) may carry leading `$…` run-time references; the loader defers such selectors (`deferred` is an internal field, rejected when user-authored) and the runtime resolves them against the run bindings before materialization.

workspace.description: Path to an AIP-10 corpus workspace root — relative to the WORKFLOW.md's directory (resolved by the loader to an absolute path) or absolute. A workspace that does not exist fails the load. Ref rule: a string containing a `$…` run-time reference (AIP-16 grammar) is left untouched at load time and resolved per run against the run bindings — only the LEADING reference token (up to the next `/`) is replaced, e.g. `$input.bookDir/knowledge` becomes `<resolved bookDir>/knowledge`; a relative resolved workspace joins to the run cwd, and a workspace that still does not exist after resolution is warned (`knowledge-workspace-missing`), not thrown.

anyOf.description: Tags with OR semantics — an entry matching ANY of these passes. Empty/absent = no tag filter. Tag strings may carry leading `$…` run-time references, resolved per run like `workspace`.

allOf.description: Tags that must ALL be present on an entry (post-filter applied after anyOf).

kinds.description: Refined-kind filter (e.g. "fact" | "howto") — only entries of these kinds pass.

maxEntries.description: Cap on materialized entries, applied after sorting by slug ascending (deterministic). Default 50.

mode.description: Materialization mode. v1 supports only "files" (write entries into the step cwd's .knowledge/); other values are rejected.

stepAgent.description: Spawn or reuse an agent session and send it a prompt.

agent.description: App-scoped agent id to resolve at compile time. Omit to spawn a plain `adapter` (no app-ref resolution) or reuse via `sessionRef`.

adapter.description: Adapter slug for spawning a NEW session. Ignored (and unnecessary) when `agent.ref` resolves one for you. Omit both to reuse via `sessionRef`.

sessionRef.description: Reuse an earlier agent step's spawned session, by that step's id.

cacheable.description: Cache this step's output under the run's cacheKey. Default false.

outputSchema.description: A JSON Schema (or, in a TS-authored workflow, a zod ZodType) validating the session's final message; re-prompts on mismatch.

options.description: Manifest-declared adapter option id → value, forwarded to a NEW spawn's `startSession({ options })` — e.g. mastra-agent's `agent` option, set by `agent.ref` resolution at compile time. Only meaningful with `adapter`; ignored on a `sessionRef` reuse. May also be authored directly on the step.

stepGate.description: Run a shell command through the host's subprocess runner (AIP-17) as a deterministic pass/fail check. Exit code 0 is a pass; any other exit code is a failure, subject to `retry`. The process' stdout, if it parses as JSON, becomes the gate's report; otherwise, when `report` names a file, that file is read (relative to `cwd`) and parsed as JSON instead. The report — plus `ok` and `exitCode` — is bound at `$steps.<id>.report` / `.ok` / `.exitCode`, and emitted as a `gate-report` lifecycle event on the run's event stream.

items.description: May carry a LEADING `$…` run-time reference (AIP-16): a leading `$input|$item|$steps.<id>|$index` token is resolved per run against the run bindings and any trailing text is appended verbatim (`$input.bookDir/knowledge` → `<resolved>/knowledge`; a string that is exactly a ref resolves to that value's string form); `$$` escapes a literal `$`; an unresolvable ref throws naming the step and the arg index.

cwd.description: Working directory. Defaults to the workflow run's own cwd. May carry the same leading-`$…` ref rule as `args` (leading token + trailing text, `$$` escape, unresolvable ref throws). The resolved cwd is made absolute: absolute stays absolute; a relative resolved cwd (incl. `.`) resolves against the run's cwd, never the daemon process cwd.

report.description: Path (relative to `cwd`) of a JSON report file, consulted when stdout doesn't itself parse as JSON.

on_fail.description: Re-prompt-and-rerun on a failing exit code, bounded by `retry.max_attempts`. Runs BEFORE each retry attempt after the first: sends the named prior agent step's session (reused the same way a `kind: "agent"` step's `sessionRef` reuse works) a prompt with this gate's last report injected, waits for its turn, then re-runs the gate command.

reprompt.description: The prior `kind: "agent"` step id to re-prompt.

with.description: Extra literal context merged into the reprompt, alongside the gate's `$steps.<id>.report`.
